title: Ramp-then-cap collimation with linear-cost merges, cap (1/4) sqrt n

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and fixed secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME algorithm TC of proof.md (collimation whose width doubles per level up to 2^Rcap, Rcap = max(ceil((1/4) sqrt n), 2v+2), with linear-cost merges, parameters computed from N as in proof.md Section 1) outputs s with unconditional probability greater than 0.99 when all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states. All four resource bounds hold jointly on EVERY execution branch, including failed merges, rejected copies, retries and aborts (hard caps, proof.md Section 9). Total charged sequential work T is O(n^(57/4) 2^((33/8) sqrt(n))); growth index of the declared envelope 1/2.

For every N>=2 and fixed secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME algorithm TC of proof.md (collimation whose width doubles per level up to 2^Rcap, Rcap = max(ceil((1/4) sqrt n), 2v+2), with linear-cost merges, parameters computed from N as in proof.md Section 1) outputs s with unconditional probability greater than 0.99 when all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states. All four resource bounds hold jointly on EVERY execution branch, including failed merges, rejected copies, retries and aborts (hard caps, proof.md Section 9). Peak classical bits S_C is O(n^(3/2) 2^((1/4) sqrt(n))); growth index of the declared envelope 1/2.

All four resource bounds hold jointly on EVERY execution branch, including failed merges, rejected copies, retries and aborts (hard caps, proof.md Section 9). Peak qubits S_Q is O(n); growth index of the declared envelope 0.

For every N>=2 and fixed secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME algorithm TC of proof.md (collimation whose width doubles per level up to 2^Rcap, Rcap = max(ceil((1/4) sqrt n), 2v+2), with linear-cost merges, parameters computed from N as in proof.md Section 1) outputs s with unconditional probability greater than 0.99 when all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states. All four resource bounds hold jointly on EVERY execution branch, including failed merges, rejected copies, retries and aborts (hard caps, proof.md Section 9). The number Q of acquired source copies (including rejected and discarded ones) is O(n^(37/4) log(n+1) 2^((33/8) sqrt(n))) for all n >= 1, hence O(n^(37/4) log(n) 2^((33/8) sqrt(n))) as n tends to infinity (the declared envelope); growth index of the declared envelope 1/2.
Clean-input guarantee only: the theorem is proved when all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states; no positive fraction of malformed copies is claimed.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
